+
+import re
+import sys
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+FASTAPI_INIT_FILE = \"fastapi/__init__.py\"
+RELEASE_NOTES_FILE = \"docs/en/docs/release-notes.md\"
+RELEASE_HEADER_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"^## (\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\")
+
+def main():
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        print(\"Usage: python scripts/release.py <new_version>\")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    new_version = sys.argv[1]
+
+    # 1. Update fastapi/__init__.py
+    with open(FASTAPI_INIT_FILE, \"r\") as f:
+        content = f.read()
+
+    new_content = re.sub(r'__version__ = \".*\"', f'__version__ = \"{new_version}\"', content)
+    with open(FASTAPI_INIT_FILE, \"w\") as f:
+        f.write(new_content)
+    print(f\"Updated {FASTAPI_INIT_FILE} to version {new_version}\")
+
+    # 2. Update docs/en/docs/release-notes.md
+    with open(RELEASE_NOTES_FILE, \"r\") as f:
+        lines = f.readlines()
+
+    inserted = False
+    new_lines = []
+    for line in lines:
+        if not inserted and RELEASE_HEADER_PATTERN.match(line):
+            new_lines.append(f\"## {new_version}\n\")
+            inserted = True
+        new_lines.append(line)
+
+    if not inserted:
+        print(\"Could not find a release header in release-notes.md to insert before.\")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    with open(RELEASE_NOTES_FILE, \"w\") as f:
+        f.writelines(new_lines)
+    print(f\"Inserted {new_version} header into {RELEASE_NOTES_FILE}\")
+
+    # 3. Run scripts/add_latest_release_date.py
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"scripts/add_latest_release_date.py\"], check=True)
+    print(\"Added date to the latest release header.\")
+
+if __name__ == \"__main__\":
+    main()
